mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the loop was most worthwhile: the result explained how opposing flows, transport and nearby vessels maintain a gradient that can drive water recovery.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the hypothalamus and pituitary was less engaging because it was the only offered combination and its result was mostly expected.

surprise.text: The explanation that nearby vessels carry recovered water away while limiting washout helped me understand that the gradient depends on ongoing flow and transport.

arbitrary.text: None felt purposeless: each combination had a clear role in the stated goals. The final two choices were automatic in practice because each was the only offered combination.

continue.text: I would probably continue for another chapter to see how the regulated kidney responds to a drink. The explanations connected the parts well, though the dense terminology and predictable final choices made it more like guided study than a puzzle.
